groups.sentence: Instructors learn what current AI systems can do and the risks of using them before teaching their course.
Instructors familiarize themselves with university generative AI policies and guidelines, reading them in full, before teaching.
Instructors stay informed about AI developments, tools and resources over time and engage in professional development.
Everyone stays informed about AI advancements, best practices and institutional guidelines as they evolve.
Students keep up with changes in AI tools, best practices and university or instructor guidance, checking back regularly.
Teaching assistants and staff stay informed about evolving AI developments, best practices and training.
Administrators keep up with AI reports, laws, regulations and policies.
Everyone keeps abreast of changes in the law, including copyright law, affecting AI use.
Everyone stays informed about AI, learns its benefits and risks, and reviews university policies and resources.
Staying informed about AI and learning about it is valuable, and resources are offered for doing so.
